proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
  intro N inst c
  change M6.Euclid.preprocessBitCost N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N) ≤ 180 * (N + 1)^3
  have ha : (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1).natDegree ≤ N := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt
    first
    | exact M7.Supports.degree_lt N c.1
    | exact M7.Supports.degree_lt c.1
  have hb : (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2).natDegree ≤ N := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt
    first
    | exact M7.Supports.degree_lt N c.2
    | exact M7.Supports.degree_lt c.2
  have hm : (M6.Cyclic.modulus N).natDegree ≤ N := by
    first
    | solve | simp [M6.Cyclic.modulus]
    | unfold M6.Cyclic.modulus
      apply le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _)
      simp
    | unfold M6.Cyclic.modulus
      apply le_trans (Polynomial.natDegree_add_le _ _)
      simp
  have h := M6.Euclid.preprocess_correct_cost N (M7.Supports.polynomial c.1) (M7.Supports.polynomial c.2) (M6.Cyclic.modulus N)
  repeat first
    | specialize h (by assumption)
    | specialize h (by omega)
  first
  | exact h
  | omega
  | aesop
